automated.summary: selection-resolution (mis-selection task 2, the story's core): a selection now resolves through the mapping master and NARROWS the single governed query path to it, exposed by the first governed-query HTTP routes. Resolution goes through task 1's exports (MAPPING_MASTER, resolveMappingTriple, canonicalPlantFromMaster) and returns an explicit DISCRIMINATED UNION - a resolved outcome (scope readout + result + bucket) or an unresolvable outcome (the 'no mapping configured' notice + zero payload) - because a FULL OUTER JOIN over two empty sources returns no rows and ResultTable alone cannot distinguish 'no data' from 'no mapping'. The notice is decided by master resolution, never by row count. Period options are the loaded actual months plus a server-derived fy26-27-ytd resolved from the latest ACTIVE LOADED month (never the wall clock), with both edges defined. GOVERNED NARROWING (0017): the Actual CTE filters the resolved (plant, cost_center, gl_code) triples on actual_by_key_month and re-aggregates to (gl_code, month) BEFORE the full outer join, so the no-fan-out invariant holds; the Budget CTE is restricted to the resolved GL set UNION the bucketed budget GLs, keeping two cases distinct - an out-of-selection GL does not appear, while a GL absent from the master still surfaces on the unmapped-GL line (the settled 0018 rule). actual_by_key_month joins objectsTouched so the validator still passes, and an unselected composed query keeps its previous path. The immutable server-owned Selection drives the executor and the resolved scope propagates through run -> executeResolved -> totalsFor -> SqlBuilder, so the ungrouped TOTALS are filtered identically to the grouped rows rather than leaking whole-plant numbers. ROUTES (decision 0019): unversioned api/mis options + run in the vendored house style, run accepting ONLY the four selectors with strict unknown-field rejection, named DTOs, documented typed errors, AuthGuard + RequireAction('report'), registered in app.module.ts and the app.routes.test.ts allow-list; the FULL semantic authorization (action + domain + every measure + every dimension) runs on the options and unresolvable branches too. Service interfaces live in their own .interface.ts files per the constitution's naming rules.
